title: Statin use and breast cancer survival
text: A nationwide cohort study found that users of statin drugs had a lower risk of breast cancer death.

title: Statin use after diagnosis of breast cancer
text: Post-diagnostic statin use was associated with lower breast cancer mortality in a cohort study.

title: Dietary fiber and cholesterol
text: Soluble fiber from oats lowers LDL cholesterol in adults with high cholesterol.

title: Vitamin D and bone density
text: Vitamin D supplementation had no effect on bone mineral density in healthy adults.
